name: tado° Smart Thermostat X (EU)

radios.note: tado° pages say it needs a Thread border router. Bluetooth for setup was not confirmed for this model.

matter.note: tado° documents a Matter setup code for its X devices, including this thermostat. A search snippet showed CSA certificate CSA23C79MAT41789-24 (Smart Thermostat X, Thread), but the CSA page itself did not surface, so it is not cited.

apple_home.note: Linked with a Matter code from the tado° app or the device QR code. Needs a Thread border router.

google_home.note: tado° has a setup guide for Google Home over Matter. Needs a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Needs a Matter-capable Echo or eero plus a Thread border router. tado° advises adding the device in its own app first to keep firmware updates.

smartthings.note: No tado° SmartThings setup guide was found.

home_assistant.note: Through Home Assistant's Matter integration, which needs a Thread border router. tado° says it does not officially support Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: No tado° bridge is needed for basic control: tado° says the Bridge X or another compatible Thread border router connects it to the internet. Without any Thread border router it cannot reach the internet. tado° X products do not work with V3+ devices.

localControl.note: No tado° page found that describes offline or local-only control.

systems.value: Boilers and heat pumps via relay or OpenTherm
systems.note: Wired to the heating system. tado° says it works with most such systems; check its compatibility checker for your boiler.

power.note: tado° says the Smart Thermostat X takes three AAA alkaline (LR03) cells. The Wired Smart Thermostat X (2nd gen) uses a built-in rechargeable battery instead and is a different product.

summary: The tado° Wired Smart Thermostat X replaces a wall thermostat and switches a boiler or heat pump through a relay or OpenTherm. It talks Matter over Thread, so Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa work through Matter, and Home Assistant uses its Matter integration. A Thread border router is needed, typically tado°'s Bridge X.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router, such as tado°'s Bridge X (sold separately, not compatible with tado° V3+ devices) or a third-party one.
tado° now also sells a 2nd-generation wired model with a rechargeable battery; check which one you are buying.
Check boiler or heat pump compatibility with tado° before buying; wiring may need a qualified installer.
